items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of an influent pump station, three 1600-gallon per minute (gpm) pumps,
Untreated wastewater flows from the influent pump station to the bar screen and then to the mixing vault.
Untreated wastewater flows from the influent pump station to the bar screen and then to the mixing vault.
Wastewater from the mixing vault then flows to the 1.5-MG activated sludge basin for primary and secondary treatment.
From the activated sludge basin, wastewater flows to the secondary clarifiers, and then to the evaporation/ percolation ponds for disposal.
Treated wastewater is discharged to the 10 percolation/evaporation ponds.
Wastewater from the RV dump station flows through three 10,000-gallon tanks in series for primary treatment
Solids from the secondary clarifiers flow to the RAS/WAS pump station where RAS is returned to the mixing vault, and WAS flows to the 1.5-MG aerobic digester.
two oil and grease separator pits (scum pits),
one 0.100-MG oil and grease aerobic containment tank,
WAS flows to the 1.5-MG aerobic digester.
